implementation.slotReads: Venue/resource/date/participant/feature context and generation guard both stale success and stale error; choice, parent-context change and cleanup invalidate synchronously.
implementation.booking: Selected slot and current booking request must share the same context identity before bookSportsSlot; unchanged transport retries reuse an idempotency key and semantic request changes reset it.
implementation.pricing: Selection amount is labeled Slot subtotal (estimate); online fee and exact total are disclosed as checkout-only; existing cancellation-policy text remains.
implementation.moneyBehavior: No client-side fee/total calculation or migration, SQL function, feature flag, payment, refund or cancellation-path change.
implementation.checkout: Existing server-returned price, customer fee and total are preserved.
